context_notes: READ BEFORE RE-OPENING THE SCENARIOS FAILURE. It was NOT a regression from a3c0408a, despite the reviewer initially confirming it as one via A/B. It is a PRE-EXISTING RACE in the spec: scenario Load calls form.requestSubmit(); expandCutLabSection read open=null on the OUTGOING page, and its queued summary click then landed on the REBUILT page after restoreSectionCollapseState had already set open - so the click toggled it CLOSED. a3c0408a merely shifted timing so the race lost more often. Because a race is nondeterministic, single runs per side proved nothing: the reviewer's baseline won the race, Codex's baseline lost it. n=1 per side on a flaky test is not an A/B. THREE MECHANISMS WERE DISPROVED AND MUST NOT BE RE-ATTEMPTED: (1) NOT click interception by the pinned header - elementFromPoint at the summary centre returns the SUMMARY itself; (2) NOT a timing window a wait would paper over - open stayed false stably from t+400ms to t+2400ms; (3) NOT the sticky positioning - forcing position:static reproduces the failure identically. Fix is 3 lines at cut-lab-scenarios.spec.ts:171 awaiting the Load navigation. ALSO: never A/B by creating a git worktree - playwright.config sets reuseExistingServer true under WSL, so a baseline worktree run silently reuses a HEAD server on :5173 and reports the wrong result; use git checkout --detach, verify curl to :5173 returns 000, and rebuild. ALSO: run e2e one spec / one project / one process / --workers=1 with /tmp/deckflow-admin-e2e.lock cleared, or admin-lock contention manufactures false failures (it produced 3 for the reviewer).
